name: Nottingham Contemporary
known: Alex Farquharson was founding director (2007 to 2015) and Sam Thorne took up the post in early 2016 (Wikipedia).

Jack Kirkland founded, funds and chairs The Ampersand Foundation, is executive chairman of the construction firm Bowmer and Kirkland, and was Chair of Nottingham Contemporary from 2015 to 2020 (Tate).

name: Modern Art Oxford
known: Trustees: chair Anna Yang, treasurer Antony Perring, Rebecca Ajulu-Bushell, Heidi Baravalle, Christina Cree, Jenny Garcia, Patrick Holmes, Beatrice Lupton and Elizabeth McCarthy;
Paul Hobson is the director.

name: Newlyn Art Gallery
known: James Green is Director and in 2025 began his 20th year in the post (gallery review "2025 in Reflection, 2026 in Sight").

name: Pier Arts Centre
known: The centre's About page names Kristopher Bevan as chair and Clare Gee as vice chair.
Collection founded by Margaret Gardiner's gift.

name: Cample Line
known: Tina Fiske is Director.

name: Yorkshire Sculpture Park
known: Founded by Peter Murray and opened in 1977.
YSP director Clare Lilley called it a "standstill award".

name: Akron Art Museum
known: Director and CEO Jon Fiume was paid $237,966 in the year to June 2025 (Form 990).

name: Anchorage Museum
known: It posts its 2023 Form 990 and names nine directors; a 2026 Gratitude Report exists but was not opened.

name: Bard College
known: Fisher Center for the Performing Arts, and the Center for Curatorial Studies (CCS Bard), whose Hessel Museum of Art opened on 12 November 2006 in a building by Goettsch Partners.

name: Aspen Art Museum
known: Founded by artists as the Aspen Center for the Visual Arts, incorporated in November 1977 and opened on 16 June 1979 with Philip Yenawine as first director.
Led by Nicola Lees, Nancy and Bob Magoon Artistic Director and CEO since April 2020, after Heidi Zuckerman.

name: Atlanta Contemporary
known: Leadership: Floyd Hall left as executive director in August 2025 after 18 months; former board chair Everett Long served as interim;
Lauren Haynes became Executive Director on 16 March 2026 (Culture Type;
Culture Type, citing the website, reports a staff of five including the interim director.

name: Blanton Museum of Art
known: Donald Goodall was the first director.
It became the Blanton in the late 1990s after a $12 million gift from Houston Endowment, Inc. in honour of its then-chairman Jack S.
Chairman's Circle, $25,000 to $99,999, includes Charles Butt, the Ford Foundation with the Austin City Art Fund, and the Carl and Marilynn Thoma Foundation.
Leadership Board, as of 31 December 2025: Aubrey Epstein (chair), Elle Moody (vice-chair), Jack Blanton, Jr., Kelli Blanton, Stacy Hock, Katya Jestin, Donald Moffett, Lora Reynolds and Judy Tate.
